decisions.reason: The DPA management tool sits close to the core offer and costs little to maintain, it fits the firm's stated compliance and agency focus, and early positive customer feedback on its templates suggests value worth keeping open while uncertainty resolves.

The hosting management platform is featured on the home page and anchors the firm's agency-focused platform strategy, so it is a core option whose value is still unfolding and worth further commitment.

The configurable managed hosting plan is a low-cost extension of established infrastructure, and there is no negative evidence yet to justify abandoning it while its market reception is still uncertain.
